system_prompt_style.note: Paper only; no prompt construction code in evidence. Rules book is sent as context to investigation agent but system prompt mechanism not shown.

env_context_strategy.note: Paper only; section-filtered rules book context described for investigation agent, not environment/repo context strategy.

context_compaction.note: No history-processing code or config in evidence; 'Section-filtered context' reduces prompt size but is not history compaction.

observation_format.note: Tool results are JSON artifacts per paper, but observation presentation to model not shown.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: a singleLlmAgent instance with 18 registered function tools
tool_call_format.note: Inferred from ADK function tools; no parser code in evidence.

tool_count.evidence_quote: a singleLlmAgent instance with 18 registered function tools
tool_count.note: Paper count; repo not available to verify.

edit_primitive.note: Invoice-processing domain; tool registry not in evidence.

tool_schema_source.note: Tool schema source not described; repo code missing.

protocol_standardization.note: Paper mentions MCP servers only as future learning opportunity; no dependency list in evidence.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Three sequential stages process each case: the acting agent produces initial output, the investigation agent validates compliance against the constitution, and theALFengine applies targeted corrections based on learned rules.
loop_primitives.note: Acting agent is nine-stage sequential pipeline (Sec. 6.2); rule safety loop repeats up to three times.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: merged into a revision plan that combines actions by tier
planning_granularity.note: Revision plan in ALF Collect-Plan-Execute; not a task-level agent plan.

multi_agent_topology.note: Reference impl is a single dual-mode LlmAgent (Sec. 6.1); conceptual architecture is a pipeline of agents.

delegation_mechanism.note: No delegation mechanism described in code terms.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: At no point is a rule applied without explicit human approval.
human_in_loop.note: SME approves learned rules before persistence in learning mode.

short_term_state.note: Per-case JSON artifacts exist but in-run state object not shown.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: persists the approved rule with full metadata: who approved it, when, which cases it was designed for, and which rules book section it relates to
long_term_memory.note: Persisted ALF rule base applied across runs; closest value file_notes.

self_verification.evidence_quote: When a potential violation is detected, atriple-check mechanismre-runs the evaluation twice more.
self_verification.note: Investigation agent LLM validates acting output against rules book; optional LLM-as-judge evaluation (Sec. 3.6).

retry_policy.note: No task-level retry described; rule safety loop up to 3 iterations is rule refinement.

rollback.evidence_quote: The Rule Writer creates a timestamped backup of the entire rule base before any modification, enabling rollback of any change.
rollback.note: Rollback of rule base, not agent workspace.

termination_condition.note: Major violation halts pipeline (Sec. 3.4.2) but run loop caps not shown.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: The discovered rules are cached with a SHA-256 hash of the rules book content, so subsequent runs skip rediscovery unless the rules book has changed.

execution_isolation.note: Runs via ADK web/CLI; isolation not described.
